notes: Curated research paths, not automatic adapters. Sources may be unavailable/outdated; check product-specific URL and shipping anew.
dailyStrategy: Prioritize 8-12 high-intent exact targets; rotate every remaining target; allow several dozen actual searches/checks, but never pretend all sources were checked.
